name: Teaching Dimension of the Three-Code Class
proof: For $000,011,101$, respectively, the labels on $x_0,x_1,x_2$ uniquely identify the target among the three concepts. No non-singleton class has teaching dimension zero. Thus $\mathrm{TD}=1$; the finite certificate is checked in $\texttt{sync/verify\_properness\_separation.py}$.
references: Direct calculation from the class definition.
